'''Jex''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mantellian Separatist Movement|Mantellian Separatist]] during the [[Separatist War]] against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], which was backing the [[Ord Mantell Central Authority]]. He was stationed in the [[Separatist Base]] on [[Mannett Point]] when a [[Meteor (Havoc Squad)|sergeant of Havoc Squad]] [[Mission to Mannett Point (Havoc Squad)|infiltrated]] the base. He was encountered by the sergeant along with his wounded Separatist fellows, but the sergeant let them go under the condition that they'd fight no more.

==Behind the scenes==
Jex first appeared in the storyline for the [[Republic trooper|Republic Trooper]] class in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', where he was voiced by [[Erik McDowell]].<ref name="TOR" />
